metadata.question: Did the area of open water around Bay Dosgris, south of New Orleans, increase from 1985 to 2024 relative to wetland areas?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance. For 1985: Landsat 5. For 2024: Landsat 8 and 9. Region: a polygon south of New Orleans encompassing Bay Dosgris vicinity. Primary window: Jun–Sep; fallback: Apr–Nov if empty. 2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds, cirrus, cloud shadows, snow via QA_PIXEL bits. Build seasonal median composites. Compute MNDWI for water (threshold > 0.1) and NDVI for wetlands (threshold > 0.3), excluding water. 3. Validity: Check ImageCollection size (C1). Count valid 1 km pixels after masking (C2). If wetland area is zero or any metric is null/NaN, return C3. If coding/data failures arise, catch and return D. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions (approximate area around Bay Dosgris, south of New Orleans) const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-90.20, 29.15], [-90.20, 29.50], [-89.50, 29.50], [-89.50, 29.15] ]); // Helpers function prepLandsatL2(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // cirrus .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // snow const isL57 = image.bandNames().contains('SR_B1'); const renamed = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If( isL57, image.select(['SR_B1','SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B7'], ['blue','green','red','nir','swir1','swir2']), image.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'], ['blue','green','red','nir','swir1','swir2']) )); const scaled = renamed.multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2).updateMask(mask); return scaled.copyProperties(image, image.propertyNames()); } function buildCollection(year, mStart, mEnd) { const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, mStart, 1); const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, mEnd, 1).advance(1, 'month'); const lt05 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2'); const le07 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2'); // fallback if needed (not for 2024) const lc08 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2'); const lc09 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2'); return lt05.merge(le07).merge(lc08).merge(lc09) .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(start, end); } async function analyzeYear(year) { // Primary window Jun–Sep let col = buildCollection(year, 6, 9); let size = await col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { // Fallback Apr–Nov col = buildCollection(year, 4, 11); size = await col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { return {status: 'C1', msg: `No images for ${year}`}; } } const prepped = col.map(prepLandsatL2); const composite = prepped.median().clip(roi); // Valid pixel counts at 1000 m const totalPix = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one') .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('one'); const validPix = composite.select('green') .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('green'); const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6).rename('area'); // km2 const mndwi = composite.expression( '(g - s) / (g + s)', {g: composite.select('green'), s: composite.select('swir1')} ); const ndvi = composite.normalizedDifference(['nir', 'red']); const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0.1); const wetlandMask = ndvi.gt(0.3).and(waterMask.not()); const waterArea = areaImg.updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('area'); const wetlandArea = areaImg.updateMask(wetlandMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('area'); const dict = ee.Dictionary({ images: col.size(), totalPix: totalPix, validPix: validPix, validFrac: ee.Number(validPix).divide(ee.Number(totalPix)), water_km2: waterArea, wetland_km2: wetlandArea }); const out = await dict.getInfo(); // Validations if (out.validPix === 0 || out.validPix === null) { return {status: 'C2', msg: `No valid pixels for ${year}`}; } const w = out.water_km2; const wl = out.wetland_km2; if (w === null || wl === null || !isFinite(w) || !isFinite(wl) || wl === 0) { return {status: 'C3', msg: `Invalid computation for ${year}`}; } const ratio = w / wl; if (!isFinite(ratio)) { return {status: 'C3', msg: `Invalid ratio for ${year}`}; } return { status: 'OK', year: year, images: out.images, totalPix: out.totalPix, validPix: out.validPix, validFrac: out.validFrac, water_km2: w, wetland_km2: wl, ratio: ratio }; } // 1985 and 2024 analyses const y1 = await analyzeYear(1985); const y2 = await analyzeYear(2024); if (y1.status !== 'OK' || y2.status !== 'OK') { // Propagate the first encountered issue code const code = y1.status !== 'OK' ? y1.status : y2.status; console.log(`1985 Images: ${y1.images || 0} ${y1.validFrac ? `(Valid: ${(y1.validFrac*100).toFixed(1)}%)` : ''}`); console.log(`2024 Images: ${y2.images || 0} ${y2.validFrac ? `(Valid: ${(y2.validFrac*100).toFixed(1)}%)` : ''}`); console.log(code); return; } // Print concise evidence const v1pct = (y1.validFrac * 100).toFixed(1); const v2pct = (y2.validFrac * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`1985 Images: ${y1.images}, Valid km-px: ${y1.validPix}/${y1.totalPix} (${v1pct}%)`); console.log(`1985 Water km2: ${y1.water_km2.toFixed(1)}, Wetland km2: ${y1.wetland_km2.toFixed(1)}, Ratio W/Wet: ${y1.ratio.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`2024 Images: ${y2.images}, Valid km-px: ${y2.validPix}/${y2.totalPix} (${v2pct}%)`); console.log(`2024 Water km2: ${y2.water_km2.toFixed(1)}, Wetland km2: ${y2.wetland_km2.toFixed(1)}, Ratio W/Wet: ${y2.ratio.toFixed(2)}`); const delta = y2.ratio - y1.ratio; console.log(`Δ Ratio (2024-1985): ${delta.toFixed(2)}`); // Final decision const answer = delta > 0 ? 'A' : 'B'; console.log(answer); } catch (e) { // Any coding/data/memory error console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
